title: The Norwegian guitarist Robert Norman
summary: Butler recalls hearing another 'demon' guitarist, Robert Norman, in Norway in the late 1930s.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: So, that's the way it goes. He affected me the same way that Oscar Ulman affected me -- that's how the affect was. That's how the effect was and a guitarist -- Whoh -- I forgot about a Norwegian boy.
His name is Robert Norman. Yes, now, that's another demon. His name is Robert Norman.
Robert Norman. He is a demon. Yes, and he will affect you too.
Did you hear him in the '30's?
Yeah, I heard him when I was up in Norway, yeah, yes indeed, and Robert was something else. I forgot all about him. Yes.
